note: Re-confirmed 2026-09-08 after the functional-design redo jump, and re-saved following that confirmation. Coverage unchanged.

coverage.target: frontend-components.md > SignupForm — the form carries no locality-selection control in any state, and the section records that none may be added. Branding renders once AC4.1.7 supplies a brand-read source; until then the unbranded functional default, per FR10.3
functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 4a into Workflow 3 — a successful signup authenticates and routes by onboarding state rather than asking the owner to choose
frontend-components.md > SignupForm > Error mapping, CONFLICT row — an inline error on the username field, not a banner: a field-level problem with a field-level fix
functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 2, and frontend-components.md > SignupForm > Validation — validation on blur and on submit, never per keystroke, with each error naming what is wrong
frontend-components.md > SignupForm > Error mapping, VALIDATION_ERROR row — each FieldError attaches to its own named field. The per-field shape is guaranteed upstream by u3-foundation's BR4.3

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 > 'Signup is untestable end-to-end regardless'. Blocked on AC4.1.8: the backend resolves the tenant from the request Host, so a frontend on its own origin makes every signup return 404 LOCALITY_NOT_RESOLVED whatever this screen does. CORS permits the request; it does not change the Host. Nothing in this unit can satisfy it

functional-spec.md > route table ('PO-0 is a state of /signup, not its own path') and Workflow 2 step 4e; frontend-components.md > SignupsUnavailable — the signup screen is replaced entirely, with no form and not a disabled one. The screen is built; its detection trigger needs AC4.1.7, recorded in the spec's Workflow 2 note

frontend-components.md > SignupsUnavailable — the component takes no ThemeTokens input in any state, so no theme can be applied even by mistake. Passing it tokens would be a defect rather than an enhancement
functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 4f — no status code or technical detail reaches any screen; u3-foundation's typed union is what makes that possible
functional-spec.md > Workflow 3 steps 2a and 2b — a just-authenticated owner is routed by onboarding state, into the wizard if incomplete and the editor if finished. The owner never chooses

functional-spec.md > Workflow 2 step 4b, and frontend-components.md > LoginForm — one identical non-disclosing banner for a wrong password and an unknown username. LoginForm has no field-level error state at all, so a later change cannot reach one by adding it for consistency with SignupForm

functional-spec.md > Workflow 1 — the routing model that would satisfy this is designed and step 3a is its path. Blocked on AC4.1.4: GET /v1/accounts/me does not exist, so no session can be restored and step 3c is what every cold load currently takes. Nothing in this unit's shape changes when the endpoint lands

frontend-components.md > ResetRequestForm — the component has no branch on account existence, because the API returns 202 either way, and the message is worded conditionally so it is not a lie in either case

functional-spec.md > route table, /reset/confirm row, and frontend-components.md > 'There is no ResetConfirmForm'. Deferred by the human's Q2 = B decision because no valid reset link can be obtained outside a direct database read: the backend generates a reset token and discards it, and there is no mailer, no SES construct and no queue
functional-spec.md > route table, /reset/expired row, and frontend-components.md > ResetLinkExpired — one state carrying a request-a-new-link action, never a dead end

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4 steps 2b and 4, and frontend-components.md > SessionExpiredDialog — an explicit session-expired state rendered over the current route, never a silent redirect and never a generic error. u3-foundation supplies the ended session and its reason (its BR1.3)
functional-spec.md > state machine, the two session-end rows — this unit routes on the ended session; the clearing of local session state itself is u3-foundation's BR1.5

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4 step 3, and frontend-components.md > SessionExpiredDialog — the dialog renders over the current route and unmounts nothing, so the editor's buffer, the wizard's entries and scroll position all survive. No success indication is shown for the failed save

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4 step 1 — this unit sees one ended session with one reason rather than several concurrent auth failures, which is the observable consequence of u3-foundation's single-flight refresh (its BR1.2)

functional-spec.md > state machine, the expiry row — a refresh-call failure arrives here as endedReason refresh-rejected and is presented as an expiry rather than retried. The rule itself is u3-foundation's BR1.3

functional-spec.md > Workflow 4 > 'What logout cannot do'. The local half is covered: this unit routes to /login and authenticated routes become unreachable. Server-side revocation is blocked on AC4.1.5 — there is no logout or revocation endpoint, so logout leaves a valid seven-day refresh token in existence
functional-spec.md > route table ('Anonymous only is a real guard') and Workflow 4 step 2a — after a sign-out, authenticated routes are unreachable including by back-navigation

frontend-components.md > HeaderUserMenu — the logout control lives in the shell header, reachable from every dashboard screen without visiting Account. US1.11 is Must and US1.15 is Should, so the Account-only route would have left a Must story with no trigger
frontend-components.md > AccountView — username, property name and locality name, read from the resolved session rather than fetched separately
frontend-components.md > AccountView — a subscription link and a logout control are both present, and nothing on the screen is drawn as though it could be edited
